# Compare before and after to see what changed

        print(f"  Node {nid} ({bn['color']}) disappeared")
    elif bn['boundary'] != an['boundary']:
        print(f"  Node {nid} ({bn['color']}) moved: {bn['boundary'][:4]} -> {an['boundary'][:4]}")
    elif bn['pixels'] != an['pixels']:
        print(f"  Node {nid} ({bn['color']}) size changed: {bn['pixels']} -> {an['pixels']}")

for nid in after_nodes:
    if nid not in before_nodes:
        print(f"  Node {nid} ({after_nodes[nid]['color']}) appeared")
